title: Financial Research Analyst (FRA)
description:
border-gray-150 overflow-hidden"> Financial Research Analyst (FRA) Full Time FINANCE GUWAHATI 3-5 yrs 1 month ago About the role Job Description Financial Research Analyst (FRA) Position Overview As a FRA, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing the financial operations of the organization in accordance with Indian accounting standards. You will play a crucial role in ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance with regulatory requirements, and providing financial insights to support decision-making. The ideal candidate should possess extensive knowledge of Indian accounting principles, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Responsibilities Oversee and manage the day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger, and bank reconciliations. Ensure compliance with Indian accounting standards, tax regulations, and other applicable laws and regulations. Review and analyze financial statements, including balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and cash flow statements, to ensure accuracy and integrity. Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to management and stakeholders, highlighting key financial insights and trends. Coordinate and support the annual external audit process, including the preparation of audit schedules, providing necessary documentation, and addressing audit queries. Supervise and provide guidance to the accounting team, including training, mentoring, and performance evaluation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives. Identify areas for process improvement and implement efficient accounting procedures and controls to enhance accuracy, productivity, and compliance. Assist in the development and implementation of accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure financial integrity. Stay updated with changes in accounting regulations and standards in India, and proactively communicate and implement any necessary changes within the organization. Conduct periodic financial analysis, variance analysis, and cost analysis to support decision-making and optimize financial performance. Monitor cash flow and manage working capital requirements to ensure adequate liquidity for the organization. Provide support during internal financial reviews, risk assessments, and other ad-hoc financial projects as required. Qualifications Bachelors / Master s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CA (Chartered Accountant) or CMA (Certified Management Accountant) are highly desirable. Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in accounting, finance, or related roles, with a focus on Indian accounting principles. In-depth knowledge of Indian accounting standards (Indian GAAP) and their practical application in financial reporting and analysis. Strong understanding of Indian tax laws and regulations, including GST, income tax, and TDS provisions. Proficient in using accounting software and tools (e.g., Tally, Zoho, Quickbooks, SAP, Microsoft Excel) to manage financial transactions, reconcile accounts, and generate reports. Demonstrated experience in supervising and leading accounting teams, with excellent leadership and mentoring skills. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret financial statements, conduct financial analysis, and present findings in a clear and concise manner. Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. 

 Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Key Skills: accounts receivable,chartered accountant,accounts payable,accountant,accounting operations,accounting,accounting software,budgeting
